defect: The fix renames the helper _RenameTable to InnerRenameTable and replaces size() with !empty() to satisfy clang-tidy.
reason: A naming and tidy cleanup with no change in behaviour, not the repair of a functional defect.

defect: The fix stops merging the outer child's distinct groups into the join's distinct-group set, so only inner-side uniqueness is used to eliminate the join.
reason: The pre-change code already merged both left_child and right_child distinct_groups; this change only moved them into pipe_info, so the wrong use of outer distinct info predates it.

defect: The fix renames the range-for variable 'pointer' in RowGroup::Serialize, which shadowed the RowGroupPointer parameter of the same name.
reason: The range expression is evaluated before the loop variable comes into scope, so the original code was valid and behaved correctly (GCC accepts it with only a -Wshadow warning); the rename is a warning cleanup.

defect: The fix removes leftover merge-conflict markers and a duplicated Serialize/Deserialize pair from json_scan.cpp.
reason: The conflict markers came from a later bad merge resolution, not from this change's signature update of JSONScan::Deserialize.

defect: CreateTable calls binder->Bind(*ref) and discards the returned BoundBaseTableRef, which owns the LogicalGet that the bind context keeps a reference to, so binding the generated-column expressions afterwards uses a dangling LogicalGet and segfaults.
reason: The fix restores the locally owned LogicalGet with an explicit AddBaseTable, which repairs exactly the segfault that the replacement lines of this change introduced.

defect: The fix registers every naive-to-TIMESTAMPTZ cast with its own implicit cast cost, through the cast function set, as part of a merge fixup.
reason: This change only rewrapped one RegisterCastFunction call; the missing implicit cost for the other source types was already there and came in through the merge.

defect: Following code review, the fix replaces the per-chunk col_names_map lookup in Flush and the name scan in SetNullUnionCols with precomputed insert_cols_idx and insert_nulls_idx vectors.
reason: The precomputed vectors give the same column mapping as the old lookups, so this is a code-review refactor of the union_by_name path, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix moves union_col_names and union_col_types from the reader options into local variables and precomputes per-reader insert index maps.
reason: This change only reformatted whitespace, and the later fix is a code-review restructuring of the union_by_name binding.

defect: The fix removes union_col_names and union_col_types from BufferedCSVReaderOptions and adds insert_cols_idx and insert_nulls_idx to the reader.
reason: Code-review API redesign of the new union_by_name option; storing the union names in options was not shown to produce wrong results.

defect: The fix wraps the first-line probe in SetPosition in try/catch and relaxes the unquote-state D_ASSERT on the column count so that it allows try_add_line mode.
reason: try_add_line and the first-line probing were introduced by later commits (24961a51 and after); the assertion added here was consistent with the code at the time.

defect: The fix edits commented-out test scaffolding and removes quoted_newline.csv from the skip list of the parallel CSV test.
reason: Test configuration change only.

defect: The fix passes the result's SQL types into compare_result and parse_datachunk so that expected CSV values are cast to the SQL type, and removes commented FAIL lines.
reason: This adapts the test helpers to the newly introduced SQLType system, which is a feature and test change, not a defect in this change's lines.

defect: The fix adds a vector<SQLType> parameter to the parse_datachunk and compare_result declarations.
reason: This change was a pure reformat; the fix is an API extension of the test helpers.

defect: The fix makes PendingQueryParameters and the reference-vector values const-reference parameters, to satisfy clang-tidy.
reason: Pass-by-value versus const-reference is a tidy and performance cleanup, not a functional defect.

defect: The new loop that finds the first valid child list entry decrements j (j--) instead of incrementing it, so it inspects only the first child entry and leaves a stale offset whenever that entry is NULL, producing wrong flatten results.
reason: The fix changes exactly this added loop from j-- to j++.

defect: The ODBC test includes "catch_stacktrace.hpp", but the header lives at duckdb/common/catch_stacktrace.hpp, so the ODBC test fails to compile.
reason: The fix corrects this include path, which is the line the change introduced; its commit message confirms the ODBC test failed to build.

defect: The fix removes a duplicate #include of duckdb/common/types/vector.hpp that remained after later merges added the same include in sorted position.
reason: The duplicate arose from later merges; this change's single added include was correct and is harmless under #pragma once.

defect: The new COLUMN_TYPES check in SniffCSV throws a BinderException whenever a named column is missing from the file being sniffed, which breaks union_by_name, where each per-file reader is sniffed with the same options and files may lack some columns.
reason: The fix skips this missing-column error when union_by_name is set, so it repairs the check this change added.

defect: SetQuoted and SetEscaped are declared static inline in base_scanner.hpp but defined only in base_scanner.cpp, while header templates in other translation units call them, which causes link failures (the Windows build broke).
reason: The fix moves the definitions inline into the header and deletes these .cpp definitions, which this commit added together with the inline declarations.

defect: The new QueryRelation::Bind calls binder.BindNode on the node cast to SelectNode, which skips the generic BindNode(QueryNode&) path that registers the CTE map and dispatches by node type, and never sets the root statement, so relations whose query has CTEs or relies on error context bind incorrectly.
reason: The fix, made the next day to repair a failing test, adds SetRootStatement and binds through BindNode(*stmt.node), correcting lines this change added.

defect: The fix restores the early-return and continue structure of BindWithReplacementScan.
reason: The nested-if and early-return versions behave identically, so this is a style refactor.

defect: UnzipCommand reads a single BUFFER_SIZE (8 MB) chunk from the gzip stream and writes only that chunk, so files that decompress to more than 8 MB are silently truncated.
reason: The fix replaces the single read and write with a loop that reads until EOF, repairing exactly the lines this change added to the test runner.

defect: The new shortcut match_sel.Initialize(state.keys_to_compare_sel) makes match_sel alias the probe state's reusable keys_to_compare_sel buffer, so later probes or set_index writes corrupt the match selection and give wrong join matches; the code itself carries a 'not sure if this is right' comment.
reason: The fix, made the same day ('bug fix because of selection'), removes this shortcut and goes back to copying indices into match_sel.

defect: The fix turns the free function GetStarChildExpression into the Binder member GetResolvedColumnExpression so that the PIVOT binding can reuse it.
reason: This is a rename and refactor that lets another fix reuse the helper; the helper's logic is unchanged.

defect: The change removed the Pin() call from the var-size sorting chunk's Advance(), so when a var-size chunk crosses into its next block during the merge, DataPtr() keeps reading the old block's data and offset pointers and compares wrong values.
reason: The fix rewrites Advance() to pin the next block (or unpin at the end) again, repairing the missing re-pin that this change introduced, together with an older off-by-one.

defect: The fix adds an offset_block flag to RowDataBlock that allocates one extra entry, because offset blocks store count+1 offsets.
reason: At this commit RowDataBlock was not used for offset blocks; offset_blocks were introduced in April 2021, so the undersized allocation comes from later code.

defect: The fix makes GetFileSize call the fsspec filesystem's size(path) instead of reading a 'size' attribute from the Python file object.
reason: The original code already used handle.attr('size'); this change only routed the access through GetHandle.

defect: The fix adds the readable_numbers argument to the TRASH-mode sqlite3_print_duckbox call.
reason: At this commit sqlite3_print_duckbox had no readable_numbers parameter, so the call matched; the parameter was added later and the fix adapts this call to the new signature.

defect: The fix factors GetDatabaseInternal out and adds a context-free GetDatabase(name), so that ATTACH IF NOT EXISTS/OR REPLACE checks the manager's current databases instead of the meta-transaction's referenced-database cache.
reason: The transaction-level referenced-database cache and the ATTACH IF NOT EXISTS waiting logic that made the lookup wrong were added by later commits (b05c504, 736706c), not by this rework.

defect: The fix casts i + 1 to int32_t in a test REQUIRE to silence a signed/unsigned comparison warning.
reason: Warning cleanup in a test; the comparison was correct for the values used.

defect: The fix resets the opened file handle, handles file_size == 0 when computing bytes_per_local_state, stops reusing the initial reader and reformats the shared_ptr lines.
reason: This change only converted Next()'s unique_ptr into a shared_ptr, and the fix only reformats those lines; the repaired behaviours are in other code.

defect: The fix marks the new CSVWriterOptions(CSVReaderOptions&) constructor explicit.
reason: Clang-tidy cleanup, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix marks the WriteCSVData(vector<string>) constructor explicit.
reason: Clang-tidy cleanup, not a functional defect.

defect: The fix wraps Fetch and FetchRaw calls in helpers that throw when the result reports a run-time error, so the Python client surfaces errors instead of returning truncated results.
reason: Unchecked fetch errors predate this change, which only added an is_open check before FetchRaw in the streaming loop.

defect: The new D_ASSERTs require scan_types.size() - 1 to equal names.size() and column_ids.size(), but names lists all table columns, so CREATE INDEX on a subset of columns hits an assertion failure in debug builds.
reason: The fix, which repaired a failing test, relaxes these assertions to <= and indexes names through column_ids; the assertions were added by this change.

defect: The re-added declaration of duckdb_table_description_error takes duckdb_table_description * while the implementation in table_description-c.cpp takes duckdb_table_description by value, so the public C API declaration conflicts with its definition.
reason: The fix ('fix copy error') corrects the parameter type in exactly this re-added declaration, and the same day in duckdb_extension.h.

defect: The fix passes strlen(s) instead of strlen(s) + 1 as the string length to WriteString, an off-by-one that over-reads by one byte and stores lengths that include the terminator.
reason: The removed code already used lengths[i] = strlen + 1 for the same WriteString call; this change only inlined that expression, so the off-by-one predates it.

defect: The debug-only verification in Scatter copies chunk_state.heap_locations with VectorOperations::Copy, which also reads the source validity mask, and Valgrind reported this; the fix copies the pointers in a plain loop.
reason: The fix replaces exactly these added debug lines, but from the code alone I cannot tell whether Copy really read uninitialized memory or Valgrind reported a false positive, and the code runs only in debug builds.

defect: The fix adds GetOrCreateInstance, which looks up or creates an instance under one lock, plus lock-free internal helpers, so that callers stop calling CreateInstance for an already cached path.
reason: This change only moved the absolute-path computation into the cache; the bug in #5371 came from the JDBC client calling CreateInstance unconditionally, and the new API is the means of fixing it.

defect: JDBC startup always calls instance_cache.CreateInstance, which throws 'Instance with path already exists' when a second connection to the same database file is opened while the first is cached, so a second JDBC connection to a file fails.
reason: The fix for #5371 replaces this added CreateInstance call with GetOrCreateInstance.
